mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user`(username, password, nickname, avatar, email, phone, subjects, role) VALUES(#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{subjects}, #{role})
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET nickname = #{nickname}, avatar = #{avatar}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, subjects = #{subjects} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `user` SET last_login_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.email, u.phone, u.subjects, u.status, u.disabled_reason AS disabledReason, u.disabled_at AS disabledAt, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, u.created_at AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course c WHERE c.user_id = u.id) AS courseCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.student_name) FROM course c2 WHERE c2.user_id = u.id AND c2.student_name IS NOT NULL AND c2.student_name != '') AS studentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization o WHERE o.user_id = u.id) AS organizationCount FROM `user` u
ORDER BY u.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET status = #{status}, disabled_reason = #{disabledReason}, disabled_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'disabled' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT id, username, nickname, avatar, email FROM `user` WHERE role = 'TEACHER' AND status = 'active'
AND (username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.email, u.phone, u.subjects, u.status, u.disabled_reason AS disabledReason, u.disabled_at AS disabledAt, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, u.created_at AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course c WHERE c.user_id = u.id AND c.start_time >= #{monthStart} AND c.start_time < #{monthEnd}) AS monthTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course c WHERE c.user_id = u.id AND c.start_time >= #{monthStart} AND c.start_time < #{monthEnd} AND c.end_time < NOW()) AS monthFinished, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(c.fee), 0) FROM course c WHERE c.user_id = u.id AND c.start_time >= #{monthStart} AND c.start_time < #{monthEnd} AND c.end_time < NOW()) AS monthIncome, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course c WHERE c.user_id = u.id AND c.start_time >= #{lastMonthStart} AND c.start_time < #{lastMonthEnd}) AS lastMonthTotal, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(c.fee), 0) FROM course c WHERE c.user_id = u.id AND c.start_time >= #{lastMonthStart} AND c.start_time < #{lastMonthEnd} AND c.end_time < NOW()) AS lastMonthIncome FROM `user` u WHERE u.id = #{id}
